A '''diamond dolabra''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[dolabra]], crafted from [[Diamond|diamonds]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 2500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diamond_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the diamond pickaxe or axe.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 8.

It mines obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 35, far faster than other blocks.

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 7 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Diamond|diamonds]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Diamond|diamond]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/diamond_from_blasting_diamond_materials.json}}</ref>
